Can I use my own face in the thumbnails?

Yes! Use the 'Upload Image' feature combined with our Flux Context model. This ensures the AI generates thumbnails that preserve your facial features and identity while changing the outfit, background, or action.
What is the best size for TikTok thumbnails?

TikTok covers are best in a 9:16 vertical ratio (1080x1920 pixels). Lovart supports this natively, or you can use the 'Expand' tool to convert square or landscape images into vertical format seamlessly.
Does Lovart write the text for me?
Yes. Our AI Agent can suggest catchy hooks based on your video topic. It then integrates that text directly into the image with professional typography that matches the visual style.
Can I edit the thumbnail after generating?
Absolutely. With ChatCanvas, you can use 'Touch Edit' to click on any part of the image to modify it, or 'Edit Text' to rewrite the headline. It's a fully editable workspace.
Is this free to try?
Yes, Lovart offers free daily credits so you can generate and experiment with TikTok thumbnails every day without a subscription.
